desc:
Dig through thrift bins for rare clothes and sneakers, then flip them for profit! A reselling simulator: find vintage tees, jerseys, hoodies and hype shoes, photograph them, list them online, ship the orders and grow your shop into a fashion empire.

NEW: The Fashion House! You and your friends walk the runway in your best finds. Plus a fairer tug-of-war and fewer pop-ups.

👕 1,700+ pieces to find, from Common to Ultra Grail
👟 The Sneaker Bin: over 400 pairs of shoes
🏢 Build your store floor by floor, hire staff, fly your own helicopter
🔁 Rebirth for bigger multipliers and unlock the Archive, the Auction House and the Estate
🔨 Put your rarest pieces up for auction and call the bids
🤝 Trade pieces with friends and wear your finds
📖 Complete your Index of rare pieces

Up to 10 players a server. Dig together, race for the best finds and build the biggest empire!
